name: Selina-4,7(11)-diene + Selina-3,7(11)-diene
evidence: Measured in 1 of 6 MONDAYS hemp SKUs at 0.78% of total volatiles (0.156mg per chew).

consumer_summary.what_it_is: Selina-4,7(11)-diene and Selina-3,7(11)-diene are a pair of closely related terpene molecules. Because they are so similar in structure, they are often grouped together when chemists analyze natural plant extracts. You would typically encounter them as part of the complex mixture of compounds that give botanical oils their distinct character.

consumer_summary.why_researchers_care: Natural-product chemists are drawn to terpenes to understand how plants interact with their environments and produce complex aromas. For this specific pair of molecules, however, there are no dedicated studies or graded evidence currently available in the literature. Future research may eventually isolate them to explore their individual potential.
